name: backward_slow_modes_x2
rationale: All 30 released checkpoints retain a strong forward/backward state-timescale asymmetry. The backward delta bias started near zero while the forward bias was initialized around -4.5. Test whether longer future context helps interpolation by doubling the memory of only the four slowest nominal backward state modes in the conditional feature extractor. Subtract log(2) from their log-decay weights, preserving the state input drive, local convolution, fast modes and all other layers. This is a structural hypothesis, not an established defect or improvement.
